notes: A new account is no longer judged against weeks that did not exist yet. Every weekly rate was divided by a full four weeks, so your first few sessions read as a huge shortfall against a month you were not there for. Three sessions in your first three days scored 28 out of 100; it now scores 80, because that is what doing everything right looks like

The same fix applies to Stamina, to Mobility, and to every muscle groups sets per week, so a first weeks training is measured against that week rather than averaged away across three weeks before you started
Once you have 28 days of history this changes nothing, and it cannot be gained either: the count starts at your very first logged session
